messages:
luis-cust: Hey team — Brightline reported a sudden drop in embeddings vectors/sec starting ~02:00 UTC, tokens/sec looks fine though. Their SLA is impacted.

jordan-support: Sorry to hear that. Do we have their request samples / dims? Any errors in logs? :eyes:

luis-cust: They sent a small repro curl. Embedding model: text-embed-512-v2, payload shows mixed dim arrays? But API returned 200s, just throughput drop.

mike-ml: Can you paste the curl and a snippet of our side logs (gpu/queue) around 02:00? I want to check kvcache and batch window behavior.

luis-cust: pasted: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input": ["short1","short2", ...], "model":"text-embed-512-v2"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings```  (they send batches of 128 but variable lengths)

alex-infra: Pulling logs now — seeing a big increase in queue_waiters and GPU wait on shard g-14 around 02:01. Snip: `WARN serve.queue: waiters=87 active_batches=3 batch_window_ms=65`

sara-ops: Also seeing elevated kernel retry rates and longer KV cache lock hold times: `kvcache.lock_time_p90=420ms`. That can blow up vectors/sec even if tokens/sec remains steady.

jordan-support: Customer says tokens/sec (tokenization counters) unchanged, embeddings per second dropped ~70%. Could be batching shrinking from dim validation fallback or a batch break due to one long input?

mike-ml: Two hypotheses: 1) Dim validation kicking in and converting to fallback small batches (vector dim transposition), 2) a new batching heuristic change that favors latency and shrank windows under mixed sizes.

alex-infra: I see a recent rollout on autoscaler/batching-policy at 01:50 — flagged as deploy by deploy-bot. Deploy ID: dpl-2026-03-17-001.

deploy-bot: dpl-2026-03-17-001 applied to staging then production route embeddings-prod at 01:52 UTC.

sara-ops: Reproduced locally: send mix of short and one 1024-token string in 128 request batch -> the batch window collapses, we get many tiny batches and kvcache thrash. Logs: `batch_flush: reason=large_seq, window=10ms`

mike-ml: Can we confirm if the model variant fallback (like quantized fallback) was triggered? That would change per-token GPU throughput and KV usage.

alex-infra: Checking logs for model-fallback markers... yes: `INFO model.router: fallback_to_variant=model-512-q4a because dim_mismatch=true` at 02:00:44 for several requests from Brightline.

jordan-support: So brightline's client is occasionally sending vectors with wrong dim metadata? Or we mis-detected dims during batching. Luis, any chance their SDK changed?

luis-cust: They updated an internal client yesterday but claim only change was retry/backoff logic. I'll ask for raw request bodies.

mike-ml: While we wait: mitigation ideas — 1) temporarily pin them to the non-fallback variant, 2) increase batch_window_ms so small batches coalesce, 3) throttle large sequences to separate path. Which is quickest?

sara-ops: Easiest: increase batch_window_ms for that shard via dynamic config to 100ms and enable kv lock backoff. That should lower kvcache contention and improve vectors/sec.

alex-infra: I can push a targeted config change to embeddings-prod shard g-14 now. Rolling change to batch_window_ms=100 and kv_lock_backoff=true. Will route 1% traffic first.

deploy-bot: config-change cfg-778 applied to 1% on g-14 at 02:15 UTC.

(six minutes pass)

alex-infra: Observability update: queue_waiters down to 12, kvcache.lock_time_p90 down to 60ms, vectors/sec for Brightline improved from 30% to ~85% of baseline.

jordan-support: Let customer know workaround applied and ask them to send full request traces so we can root-cause the dim mismatch.

luis-cust: Notified Brightline, they're running a new test now. They reported improvement and will give us full traces. :thumbsup:

mike-ml: Follow-up action items: 1) correlate client SDK change with dim metadata, 2) add stricter dim validation logs to be non-fatal (so we don't fallback silently), 3) create a canary test for mixed-length batches to catch regressions.

sara-ops: Filed ticket INFRA-834: increase batch coalescing and add kvcache metrics + alert.

jordan-support: Closing the thread when Brightline confirms stable. Thanks all. :pray:
